confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Amsterdam price levels; no live listings, booking pages, or menus were inspected. Beer, coffee, and restaurant anchors are moderately reliable. July hostel and hotel rates are the least certain because they swing with event calendars and booking lead time. Cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to the beer anchor using typical local price relationships (cocktail about 2.9 times beer, wine glass about 1.7 times beer) because direct knowledge of exact bar pricing is limited.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against typical Western European capital and canal or heritage tourist-city price tiers, such as Brussels and Copenhagen, with July accommodation set for peak-season demand. No single named comparable city supplied any specific figure.
